turns.text: BREAKING: local loading-dock cat evades capture for the four-hundredth consecutive night, sources say he's 'annoyed it's not five hundred yet.'

name's KNIFEBOY, Restricted Loading Dock, freelance shanker of meowtoids. tonight's shipment: 200 crates of NEKOCORP 'Premium Tuna-Flavored Tuna.' left a note. note said 'nice supply chain, CHUD.' I stand by the grammar.

bounty's up to 40,000 loyalty points now. points expire in 90 days. cannot be combined with other promotions. my own government coupon-capped my manhunt. couldn't make it up if I tried, and I DO try, constantly, it's my whole thing.
SHADE texted a heads up about drones near dock 9. didn't even ask, just sent coordinates and 'stay based.' say what you want about the sunglasses guy, man delivers.

police description on file: 'smol fan of cat foids, destroyer of feline chuds.' framed it. hung it in my hideout. best review I've ever gotten and I've stolen from four different NEKOCORP subsidiaries.

spotted a KILLDOZER-pattern paint job idling by the dock earlier. either it's BRIK doing recon out of solidarity or NEKOCORP finally learned to reuse assets. betting on solidarity. always bet on the vent guy.

tally for tonight: crates jacked, 6. notes left, 6. loyalty points earned, 0, because apparently theft doesn't count toward the rewards program, which honestly is the most NEKOCORP sentence I've ever said out loud.
anyway. dock's clear, bounty's up, note's written, tuna's mine. see everyone at large—
